label: How it works
heading: From first conversation to first distribution.

steps.title: Join the list
steps.body: Tell us about your goals and confirm whether you are an accredited investor.

steps.title: Intro call
steps.body: A 30-minute call with our founders about strategy, fit and your questions.

steps.title: Review an offering
steps.body: Receive the investment summary, private placement memorandum and operating agreement.

steps.title: Invest
steps.body: Verify accreditation, sign and fund securely through the investor portal.

steps.title: Stay informed
steps.body: Quarterly letters, distributions and K-1s, all in one place.
